brain_faqs.question: When are you open?
brain_faqs.answer: Our regular team support hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–6 PM. We're closed on Sundays. Our WhatsApp AI assistant can help 24/7 when the automation is operational.

brain_faqs.question: How can I contact you?
brain_faqs.answer: You can reach BrandHive Studio through: WhatsApp / Phone: +94 70 641 0093, Email: brandhive.studio.lk@gmail.com, Website: www.brandhivestudio.com.lk. You can also find us on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

brain_faqs.question: How do I get started?
brain_faqs.answer: Simply tell us what you'd like to build or improve. We'll understand your requirements, recommend the most suitable BrandHive service, and arrange a quotation where needed.

brain_faqs.question: Do I need to pay in advance?
brain_faqs.answer: Yes. For most projects, we require a 50% advance to begin, with the remaining 50% due before final delivery. Larger or custom projects may use milestone-based payments.

brain_faqs.question: Can I get an individual service instead of a package?
brain_faqs.answer: Yes. Individual services are available across most categories, so you don't always need to choose a package.

brain_faqs.question: Can you prepare a custom quotation?
brain_faqs.answer: Yes. BrandHive Studio can prepare custom quotations based on your business goals, requirements and project scope.

brain_faqs.question: Who owns the final work?
brain_faqs.answer: Final approved deliverables are transferred after full payment unless otherwise agreed in the quotation.

brain_faqs.question: Do you handle domain and hosting?
brain_faqs.answer: Domain registration, hosting and other third-party services are generally billed separately unless they're included in your quotation.

brain_faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
brain_faqs.answer: Yes. Maintenance and ongoing support options are available depending on the service and package.

brain_faqs.question: Are revisions included?
brain_faqs.answer: Yes. Revision availability depends on the selected service, package or quotation.

brain_faqs.question: How long will my project take?
brain_faqs.answer: Delivery depends on the project scope, complexity and timely client feedback. Once we understand your requirements, the BrandHive team can provide a more accurate timeline.

brain_faqs.question: Can I see your portfolio or past work?
brain_faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can explore our work through the BrandHive Studio portfolio on our website.
